subject: Logic
title: Burden of Proof
description: A short lesson to help you apply Burden of Proof.

hook.text: I have an invisible dragon in my garage. You can't prove I don't. Does that mean the dragon exists?

buildup.text: The burden of proof falls on the person making the claim—especially extraordinary claims.

discovery.text: You can't prove a negative exhaustively. That's why the claimant must provide positive evidence.

twist.text: Shifting the burden is a common trick: make a wild claim, then demand others disprove it.

climax.text: Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence. The bigger the claim, the heavier the proof required.

punchline.text: You made the claim. You bring the proof.

quiz.question: Who bears the burden of proof?
